name: The Evils
summary: The Evils is a satirical supervillain management game where you run your own customized supervillain organization! Wreak havoc on a fearful populace by recruiting an array of powerful supervillains with over the top personalities. Explore and Exploit the weird resources of an atompunk world while your minions battle to Exterminate the authorities and do-gooder Superheroes. But don't forget the other criminal organizations! They'll retaliate with full force as you build empires, manage your logistic chains, infiltrate enemy structures, perform an array of ludicrous Rackets and Expand your evil empire across the globe - and beyond!
